result.instructions: Tools for ZekerFlex, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open shifts do we have this week, and how many positions are still unfilled?"; "Show the approved timesheets from the last two weeks and their billable minutes."; "List the invoices we received since 1 October.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ZekerFlex data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zekerflex_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zekerflex_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zekerflex_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zekerflex_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zekerflex_list_open_shifts
tools.title: List open shifts
tools.description: List the open shifts of your organization: title, start and end time, hourly rate in eurocents, number of positions, status (OPEN, MATCHING or PARTIALLY_FILLED), branch and city. Needs the shifts:read scope. Uses GET /shifts.

tools.name: zekerflex_get_shift
tools.title: Get a shift
tools.description: Get one shift of your organization by id, with the people scheduled on it (first name and initial). Needs the shifts:read scope. Uses GET /shifts/{id}.

tools.name: zekerflex_list_approved_timesheets
tools.title: List approved timesheets
tools.description: List approved and paid timesheets of your organization, most recently approved first: scheduled start and end, billable minutes, hourly rate in eurocents, branch and freelancer name. Needs the timesheets:read scope. Uses GET /timesheets/approved.

tools.name: zekerflex_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices issued to your organization, newest first. Optionally only invoices since a date. Needs the invoices:read scope. Uses GET /invoices.

since.description: Only invoices from this date on, yyyy-mm-dd.
